Name: Fish Basket
Author: DarkScorpion
Description:
Fish Basket — Catch better fish, less trash!


Ever wished crab pots were more rewarding? Fish Basket adds four placeable, craftable baskets that work like crab pots but actually catch fish instead of trash — with quality scaling based on the tier you build.
Features

4 tiers: Basic → Silver → Gold → Iridium

Higher tiers catch better quality fish (up to Iridium quality)
Higher tiers also reduce the chance of pulling up trash
Placeable on any valid crab pot tile (waterfront farms, beaches, etc.)
Custom sprite with visible quality star on the basket
Craftable: each tier requires one fish of the matching quality
Fully translatable (11 languages included)
GMCN support (Generic Mod Config Menu) — tweak junk rates per tier
Optional bait requirement (disabled by default)


How it works
Craft a Fish Basket at a crafting station (unlocked at Fishing level 3)
Place it in the water like a crab pot
Come back the next day — collect the fish!
Right-click to harvest the catch, or pick up the basket to move it


Config options
Language override (auto-detect or force a specific language)
Requires bait toggle
Junk chance multiplier per tier (0.0 = no junk, 5.0 = lots of junk)
Translations included
English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Italiano, Türkçe, Magyar


Requirements
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0.0+


Installation
Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io)
Unzip Fish Basket into your Mods folder
Launch the game via SMAPI


Roadmap: Custom Icons (not the Crabpot)
